name: Camera
what: Take photos and record video, and see whatever the lens sees while the app is open.
danger: A malicious app could capture images without you noticing. Watch for the camera indicator dot or light on your phone.
tip: Allow only while using the app.

name: Microphone
what: Record audio, including for calls, voice notes and video.
danger: Misused, it can listen to conversations around you.
tip: Allow only while using the app, and check that the microphone indicator is off when you are not recording.

name: Location
what: Find where you are, roughly (city area) or precisely (street level).
danger: Reveals where you live, work and travel, and that history can be sold or leaked.
tip: Choose approximate location unless the app truly needs exact positioning.

name: Location in the background
what: Track where you are even when the app is closed or the screen is off.
danger: Builds a detailed log of your daily movements, including home, work and routines.
tip: Keep it off unless the app is tracking a trip or workout you started.

name: Contacts
what: Read, and sometimes change, the names, numbers and emails in your address book.
danger: Exposes other people's details without their consent and feeds spam and scams.
tip: Share contacts only with apps whose main job is reaching them.

name: SMS messages
what: Read or send text messages, including one-time codes sent by banks.
danger: Lets an app read verification codes to take over accounts, or send premium-rate texts that charge you.
tip: Deny unless the app is your default messaging app.

name: Call logs
what: See who you called, who called you, and when.
danger: Reveals your relationships and habits, and can be used for profiling or fraud.
tip: Almost no app other than a phone or dialer app needs this.

name: Photos and files
what: Read, save or delete pictures, videos and documents on your phone.
danger: Private photos and documents could be copied off your device.
tip: Where offered, pick only the photos you want to share instead of giving full library access.

name: Calendar
what: Read and add events, including titles, places and attendees.
danger: Shows your schedule, who you meet and when your home is empty.
tip: Allow only for apps that add or manage events for you.

name: Bluetooth and nearby devices
what: Connect to earbuds, watches, cars and other devices close to you.
danger: Can be used to detect nearby devices and track your presence in places like shops.
tip: Allow for apps that connect to a device you own.

name: Body sensors
what: Read health data such as heart rate from your phone or wearable.
danger: Health data is very personal and valuable to advertisers and insurers.
tip: Allow only for health apps you trust, and check how they store the data.

name: Accessibility service
what: See what is on your screen and tap or type for you. It is meant for assistive tools.
danger: Malware abuses it to read passwords and approve payments without you. It is one of the most dangerous permissions.
tip: Grant it only to assistive apps you installed for that purpose.

name: Display over other apps
what: Draw windows on top of other apps, such as floating bubbles.
danger: Criminals use it to place fake login screens over real banking apps.
tip: Deny unless the app has a floating feature you actually use.

name: Notifications
what: Show alerts on your lock screen and notification shade.
danger: Mostly an annoyance: spam alerts, and private messages visible on a locked screen.
tip: Allow the alerts you want and switch off the rest.
